text: Hey, I haven’t seen you in a while. How are you? I’m good, thanks. I’m just wondering what I should choose to study. You graduated last year, right? What are you doing these days? Actually, I’m working as a Swedish translator. That sounds really cool! How did you get into that? Well, I got my degree in Swedish Studies, and I had a part-time job in my final year in school with a company that does translations. They liked my work and offered me a job after graduation, so it all worked out perfectly. Wow, that’s great! I’ve been thinking about getting a degree in something like International Studies or maybe Russian Studies. You should definitely look into Russian Studies! If it’s like Swedish Studies, then it will be an interesting field, and it can lead to some great career opportunities. Hmm. I haven’t thought about jobs for people with a degree in Russian Studies. Do you think I would like it? Yeah, I think you would. And if you’re interested in Russian culture, too, then it would be a perfect fit for you. Alright, well thanks for the advice! I’ll definitely look into it more and see if it’s the right fit for me.
